arxiv-2103-06164.title: Model-inspired Deep Learning for Light-Field Microscopy with Application to Neuron Localization
arxiv-2103-06164.creator: Pingfan Song, Herman V. Jadan, Carmel Howe, Peter Quicke, Amanda Foust, Pier Luigi Dragotti
arxiv-2103-06164.description: Abstract Light-field microscopes are able to capture spatial and angular information of incident light rays. This allows reconstructing 3D locations of neurons from a single snap-shot. In this work, we propose a model-inspired deep learning approach to perform fast and robust 3D localization of sources using light-field microscopy images.

arxiv-2104-07814.title: Detecting Polarized Topics Using Partisanship-aware Contextualized Topic Embeddings
arxiv-2104-07814.creator: Zihao He, Negar Mokhberian, António Câmara, Andrés Abeliuk, Kristina Lerman
arxiv-2104-07814.description: Abstract Growing polarization of the news media has been blamed for fanning disagreement, controversy and even violence. Early identification of polarized topics is thus an urgent matter that can help mitigate conflict. However, accurate measurement of topic-wise polarization is still an open research challenge.

arxiv-2206-02089.title: Avoiding localization instabilities in rotary pleating
arxiv-2206-02089.creator: Tian Yu, J. A. Hanna
arxiv-2206-02089.description: Abstract Rotary pleating is a widely used process for making filters out of nonwoven fabric sheets. This involves indirect elastic-plastic bending of pre-weakened creases by continuously injecting material into an accordion-shaped pack. This step can fail through a localization instability that creates a kink in a pleat facet instead of in the desired crease location.

arxiv-2309-00823.title: Quantum Harish-Chandra isomorphism for the double affine Hecke algebra of GL n
arxiv-2309-00823.creator: Joshua Jeishing Wen
arxiv-2309-00823.description: Abstract . We prove that for generic parameters, the quantum radial parts map of Varagnolo and Vasserot gives an isomorphism between the spherical double affine Hecke algebra of G ​ L n GL_{n} and a quantized multiplicative quiver variety, as defined by Jordan. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary: 20C08, 33D52, 53D55; Secondary: 16G20. 1.

arxiv-2309-02559.title: Localized f f -electron magnetism in the semimetal Ce 3 Bi 4 Au 3
arxiv-2309-02559.creator: M. O. Ajeesh, S. K. Kushwaha, S. M. Thomas, J. D. Thompson, M. K. Chan, N. Harrison, J. M. Tomczak, P. F. S. Rosa
arxiv-2309-02559.description: Abstract Ce 3 Bi 4 Au 3 crystallizes in the same non-centrosymmetric cubic structure as the prototypical Kondo insulator Ce 3 Bi 4 Pt 3 . Here we report the physical properties of Ce 3 Bi 4 Au 3 single crystals using magnetization, thermodynamic, and electrical-transport measurements. Magnetic-susceptibility and heat-capacity data reveal antiferromagnetic (AFM) order below T N = 3.

arxiv-2402-10264.title: Neutrino-Dark Sector Equilibration and Primordial Element Abundances
arxiv-2402-10264.creator: Cara Giovanetti, Martin Schmaltz, Neal Weiner
arxiv-2402-10264.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Cara Giovanetti, Martin Schmaltz, Neal Weiner. After neutrinos decouple from the photon bath, they can populate a thermal dark sector. If this occurs at a temperature above ∼ 100 ​ keV \sim 100\,{\rm keV} , this can have measurable impacts on light element abundances.

arxiv-2409-13015.title: First Resolution of Microlensed Images of a Binary-Lens Event
arxiv-2409-13015.creator: Zexuan Wu, Subo Dong, A. Mérand, Christopher S. Kochanek, Przemek Mróz, Jinyi Shangguan, Grant Christie, Thiam-Guan Tan, Thomas Bensby, Joss Bland-Hawthorn, Sven Buder, Frank Eisenhauer, Andrew P. Gould, Janez Kos, Tim Natusch, Sanjib Sharma, Andrzej Udalski, J. Woillez, David A. H. Buckley, I. B. T
arxiv-2409-13015.description: Abstract We resolve the multiple images of the binary-lens microlensing event ASASSN-22av using the GRAVITY instrument of the Very Large Telescope Interferometer (VLTI). The light curves show weak binary-lens perturbations, complicating the analysis, but the joint modeling with the VLTI data breaks several degeneracies, arriving at a strongly favored solution.

arxiv-2505-19632.title: Krein space quantization and New Quantum Algorithms
arxiv-2505-19632.creator: M. V. Takook
arxiv-2505-19632.description: Abstract . Krein space quantization and the ambient space formalism have been successfully applied to address challenges in quantum geometry (e.g., quantum gravity) and the axiomatic formulation of quantum Yang-Mills theory, including phenomena such as color confinement and the mass gap.

arxiv-2506-17417.title: Aha Moment Revisited: Are VLMs Truly Capable of Self Verification in Inference-time Scaling?
arxiv-2506-17417.creator: Mingyuan Wu, Meitang Li, Jingcheng Yang, Jize Jiang, Kaizhuo Yan, Zhaoheng Li, Minjia Zhang, Klara Nahrstedt
arxiv-2506-17417.description: Abstract Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated that inference-time computation techniques, such as decoding-time scaling and self-refinement, can significantly enhance reasoning capabilities without relying on external knowledge. A key driver of this success is the emergence of self-correction and self-verification behaviors, often elicited through reinforcement learning (RL).

arxiv-2509-18510.title: Curvature of basis exchange walks
arxiv-2509-18510.creator: Isabel Detherage
arxiv-2509-18510.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Isabel Detherage. We prove both lower and upper bounds on the Ollivier-Ricci curvature of the basis exchange walk on a matroid. We give several examples of non-negatively curved basis exchange walks and negatively curved basis exchange walks. 1
Introduction

Recent works have shown the basis exchange walk on matroids have several nice properties: fast mixing
[
ALG+21
]
, 1-spectral independence, and a lower bounded modified log Sobolev constant
[
CGM19
]
.

arxiv-2602-12310.title: ChemRecon: a Consolidated Meta-Database Platform for Biochemical Data Integration
arxiv-2602-12310.creator: Casper Asbjørn Eriksen, Jakob Lykke Andersen, Rolf Fagerberg, Daniel Merkle
arxiv-2602-12310.description: Abstract Abstract Summary: In this paper, we present ChemRecon, a meta-database and Python interface for integrating and exploring biochemical data across multiple heterogenous resources by consolidating compounds, reactions, enzymes, molecular structures, and atom-to-atom maps from several major databases into a single, consistent ontology.

pmc-10508347.creator: Corinne Wiesner-Friedman, Rachelle E. Beattie, Jill R. Stewart, Krassimira R. Hristova, Marc L. Serre
pmc-10508347.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). IntroductionAntimicrobial resistance (AMR) is an increasing public health concern for humans, animals, and the environment. However, the contributions of spatially distributed sources of AMR in the environment are not well defined.MethodsTo identify the sources of environmental AMR, the novel microbial Find, Inform, and Test (FIT) model was applied to a panel of five antibiotic resistance-associated genes (ARGs), namely, erm(B), tet(W), qnrA, sul1, and intI1, quantified from riverbed sediment and surface water from a mixed-use region.ResultsA one standard deviation increase in the modeled

pmc-10844487.title: Association between gastroesophageal reflux disease and stroke: a bidirectional Mendelian randomization study
pmc-10844487.creator: Decheng Meng, Xin Zhang, Wenfei Yu, Guoliang Yin, Suwen Chen, Hongshuai Liu, Linya Wang, Fengxia Zhang
pmc-10844487.description: ObjectiveSome previous studies have suggested a potential link between stroke and gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD). We used a two-sample bidirectional Mendelian randomization (MR) method to explore the causal relationship between stroke and GERD.DesignSummary-level data derived from the published genome-wide association studies (GWAS) were employed for analyses.

pmc-11503439.title: Sports Injury Surveillance Systems: A Scoping Review of Practice and Methodologies
pmc-11503439.creator: Damien Costello, Ed Daly, Lisa Ryan
pmc-11503439.description: Background: Injury prevention/reduction strategies are driven by data collected through injury surveillance systems. The aim of this review was to describe injury surveillance systems that are used for ongoing surveillance in either a professional or amateur sporting environment. This was an update to a review done in 2015 to determine the gaps in injury surveillance.

pmc-11675242.title: Primary Health Care Systems and Their Contribution to Universal Health Coverage and Improved Health Status in Seven Countries: An Explanatory Mixed-Methods Review
pmc-11675242.creator: Anjana Rai, Resham B. Khatri, Yibeltal Assefa
pmc-11675242.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Primary health care (PHC) systems and their successes and challenges vary between and within countries. We elucidate the role of PHC on health status and universal health coverage (UHC) by describing the achievements and challenges of PHC systems in seven countries representing the three economic levels: high-income (Belgium, Australia), middle-income (South Africa, Thailand), and low-income countries (Cambodia, Ethiopia, and Nepal).

pmc-12491407.title: Machine learning framework to extract physicochemical features of B-cell epitopes recognized by a cross-reactive antibody
pmc-12491407.creator: Simranjit Grewal, Uwa Iyamu, Daniel Ferrer Vinals, Catherine J. Mitran, Nidhi Hegde, Stephanie K. Yanow
pmc-12491407.description: During infection with Plasmodium falciparum in pregnancy, parasites express a unique virulence factor, VAR2CSA, that mediates binding of infected red blood cells to the placenta. A major goal in designing vaccines to protect pregnant women from malaria is to elicit antibodies to VAR2CSA.

pmc-12502620.title: Streptomyces huangiella sp. nov., an endophytic actinomycete isolated from Pheretima aspergillum, a promising candidate for biological pathogen control
pmc-12502620.creator: Dan Huang, Jinli Tan, Jingyang Liao, Liuchong Zhu, Xiang Zhang, Donghua Feng, Wenbin Liu, Xiaobao Jin
pmc-12502620.description: Pheretima aspergillum (E. Perrier) is an annelid of the genus Pheretima in the family Megascolecidae, a species of earthworm, whose dried body (Guang Dilong) is a traditional Chinese animal medicine. A new actinobacterium strain, named HD1123-B1T, was isolated from the gut contents of Pheretima aspergillum caught in the wild in Guangzhou, China.

pmc-12542501.title: Quality preservation of jujube fruit during cold storage: effect of maturity stage and modified atmosphere packaging
pmc-12542501.creator: Sefa Gun, Burhan Ozturk, Erdal Aglar, Orhan Karakaya
pmc-12542501.description: BacgroundThis study, which examines the effect between the maturity stage and modified atmosphere packaging (MAP) in order to prevent post-harvest quality losses and extend the storage life of jujube (Ziziphus jujuba Mill.) fruit, offers an important contribution to supply chain management. The fruits harvested at different maturity stages were stored at 0 ± 0.

pmc-12552698.title: Autoimmune reactions to ACE2 triggered by SARS-CoV-2 S protein and their histopathological consequences
pmc-12552698.creator: Liubov Beduleva, Kseniya Fomina, Tatyana Khramova, Alexey Terentiev, Daria Menshikova, Oksana Terentieva, Igor Menshikov, Alexandr Sidorov, Polina Makhankova, Nadezhda Abisheva
pmc-12552698.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). SARS-CoV-2 has been shown to induce autoimmunity. Due to the idiotype-antiidiotypic interactions between lymphocytes to SARS-CoV-2 S protein and lymphocytes to angiotensin converting enzyme 2 (ACE2), the immune response to S protein can cause induction of anti-ACE2 lymphocytes. The ubiquity of ACE2 within the human body endows autoimmune reactions to ACE2 with the role of the main factor causing injuries of various tissues.

pmc-12691085.title: Ontogeny of Melatonin Secretion and Functional Maturation of the Pineal Gland in the Embryonic Turkey (Meleagris gallopavo)
pmc-12691085.creator: Magdalena Prusik, Claudia Giannetto, Francesca Aragona
pmc-12691085.description: Simple SummaryThe pineal gland is a key neuroendocrine organ responsible for the production of melatonin (MLT), which regulates circadian rhythms in birds. Although the turkey is known for its exceptionally light-sensitive pineal gland after hatching, little has been known about its function during embryonic development.

pmc-12996805.title: Perioperative chemotherapy (FLOT 4 + 4) versus total neoadjuvant therapy (TNT; FLOT ×8) for resectable gastric cancer: A systematic review and exploratory meta-analysis
pmc-12996805.creator: Rafael Novaes Jardim, Vitório Augusto Alexandre Alves, Alessandro D. Mazzotta, Jayant Kumar, Omar Llaguna, Mohamed Ali Chaouch, Elio Pietro Perrone, Eulália Dalba Elias da Silva, Laura Correia Jacinto, Moacyr Jesus Barreto de Melo Rego, Nagy Habib, Adriano Carneiro da Costa
pmc-12996805.description: IntroductionGastric and gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) adenocarcinoma is associated with high recurrence rates despite curative-intent surgery. Standard perioperative chemotherapy (PC) using FLOT (4 preoperative + 4 postoperative cycles) improves survival but is frequently not completed because of postoperative morbidity. Total Neoadjuvant Therapy (TNT), which delivers all eight FLOT cycles preoperatively (FLOT ×8), has been proposed to improve treatment completion.

pmc-13139919.title: An index of maximal expiratory flow–volume curve with different features related to central and peripheral concavity
pmc-13139919.creator: Fumi Mochizuki, Hiroaki Iijima, Susumu Sato, Takafumi Shimada, Naoya Tanabe, Shigeo Muro, Nobuyuki Hizawa
pmc-13139919.description: ExtractWe read the recent article by Tan et al. [1] entitled “Concavity of the maximal expiratory flow–volume curve, and incidence of COPD and respiratory symptoms: a population-based cohort study”, published in ERJ Open Research. This is an intriguing study demonstrating that the concavity indices, central concavity and peripheral concavity, are useful markers for assessing the future risk of respiratory symptoms.

pmc-13144560.title: Optimizing single molecule, real-time sequencing for enhanced characterization of adeno-associated viral vector genomes
pmc-13144560.creator: Julia Manz, Raphael Ruppert, Markus Haindl, Jürgen Hubbuch, Johannes Pschirer
pmc-13144560.description: Monitoring the payload of recombinant adeno-associated viral vectors (rAAVs) used for gene therapy applications is essential. Long-read sequencing is a promising method to confirm not only the identity of the packaged DNA but also to assess its integrity with regard to truncations, deletions, insertions, and chimeras.

pmc-13194684.title: Genetic diversity and phylogeography of Chimaera monstrosa (Linnaeus, 1758) in the Mediterranean Sea: insights from COI mitochondrial DNA analysis
pmc-13194684.creator: Nuri Başusta, Naim Saglam
pmc-13194684.description: Chimaera monstrosa (Linnaeus, 1758) is a deep-water cartilaginous fish classified as Vulnerable globally and Near Threatened in the Mediterranean by the IUCN, yet its population genetic structure remains poorly characterised across much of its range. Here, we report the first mitochondrial cytochrome c oxidase subunit I (COI) sequences of C.

pmc-13352745.title: Effects of behavioural interventions for preventing obesity in young children from ethnic minority backgrounds: a systematic review of randomised controlled trials
pmc-13352745.creator: Erica J. Cook, Jane Williams, Louisa Donald, Ffion Curtis, Chris Bridle, Amy Ridge, Jamie M. Whitehall, Faye Powell
pmc-13352745.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundTackling childhood obesity represents a significant public health challenge associated with several adverse health and psychological outcomes, with increased prevalence in ethnically diverse populations. Early intervention is required to promote healthy weight from early childhood and reduce health inequalities.

pmc-13679864.title: Clinical, Economic, and System-Level Outcomes of Bariatric Surgery in Adults: Protocol for a Systematic Review
pmc-13679864.creator: Michał Bystram, Marlena Robakowska, Monika Proczko-Stepaniak, Javad Sarvestan
pmc-13679864.description: BackgroundObesity affects approximately 880 million adults worldwide and carries substantial health, economic, and social consequences. Although bariatric surgery achieves sustained weight loss and metabolic improvement, existing systematic reviews largely predate 2020 and rarely integrate clinical, economic, and system-level perspectives within a single synthesis.
